name: Larécume
source:
The main character Minato, who was born and raised in the countryside of a small port town, felt a little stuffy in a small community. Minato, who is not good at speaking, hasn't had any friends since he was little, and he spent his time alone looking at the sea.

One day, he meets Lucas, who pops out of the sea as he hears his voice as he looks at the sea as usual and wonders where he is. He thought it was a strange encounter, but he gradually became friends with Lucas, who is friendly and good at talking.

Minato thought he his life was stuffy, but since he met Lucas, every day has become fun. Minato, who was living such a daily life, is invited by Lucas to "play together" one day. He wondered if he would play somewhere other than the sea, and he agreed, and he was dragged into the sea.

Minato, who can't swim, prepares for his death, but he wants to live because he enjoyed his daily life with Lucas. He noticed that she was supported as Lucas's voice, which told him to calm down, reached Minato's ears. He finds there that the lower body of Lucas is not human. When he explained to Lucas that he wanted to play with him, he couldn't even swim, let alone dive, Lucas suggested that he had a good idea: "kissing him" or "drinking his blood." It was that.

So what is Minato's choice?

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220601104939/https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6653]NovelGame[/url]]
translation:
主人公凑在偏远的小港镇出生、长大，对狭小封闭的人际圈感到有些窒息。他不善言辞，从小就没有朋友，总是独自望着大海。

某天，他一如既往地眺望海面，忽然听见一个声音。正当他寻找声音的来源时，吕卡从海中探出头来。虽然觉得这场相遇有些奇怪，但面对开朗健谈的吕卡，他还是渐渐与对方成了朋友。

原本让凑感到压抑的生活，因为与吕卡相识，每一天都变得快乐起来。一天，吕卡邀请他“一起玩”。凑心想，也许这次要去海边以外的地方，便答应了，结果却被拉进了海里。

不会游泳的凑已经做好了赴死的准备，可与吕卡共度的快乐时光，又让他萌生了活下去的渴望。这时，吕卡让他冷静下来的声音传入耳中，他才意识到，对方正托着自己的身体。他也终于发现，吕卡的下半身并非人类的模样。凑解释说，虽然想和他一起玩，但自己别说潜水，就连游泳也不会。吕卡于是提出了一个好主意：“亲吻他”，或是“喝下他的血”。

那么，凑会如何选择呢？

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220601104939/https://novelgame.jp/games/show/6653]NovelGame[/url]]
